# Generated evidence: uniswap/allow-router

Written by `pnpm report uniswap/allow-router --record` from `templates/uniswap/allow-router/template.json`, `templates/uniswap/allow-router/docs.json`, `registry/contracts.json`, `testdata/report/uniswap-allow-router.json`, `testdata/abi`, `testdata/research/uniswap-allow-router-permit2.json`. The listings and pages were read on 2026-11-17. `pnpm test` computes it again from these files and fails on any difference: every section is recomputed from the recorded answers except the vault evidence, which is stored as `pnpm instance-evidence` printed it. The recordings were made on the AI's computer, and no program reads their answers live again. Text from outside the program appears only as identifiers: a contract name Etherscan gives, printed only when it is a Solidity identifier, and the file paths, field paths and format names `pnpm erc7730` prints. The URLs come from the registry and `docs.json`, in RFC 3986 characters only. Text the AI wrote appears only where a row says it was written by the AI in the template. Do not edit this file.

## Effects

The Safe gives and gets nothing: any change to its balances is a `MISMATCH`.

The Safe's allowance of the card's `token`: one of `usdc` `0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48`, `usdt` `0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7`, `morpho` `0x58D97B57BB95320F9a05dC918Aef65434969c2B2`, `cbbtc` `0xcbB7C0000aB88B473b1f5aFd9ef808440eed33Bf`, `usp` `0x098697bA3Fee4eA76294C5d6A466a4e3b3E95FE6`, `weeth` `0xCd5fE23C85820F7B72D0926FC9b05b43E359b7ee`, inside Permit2, to registry `universal-router-2.1.2` `0x23617e59A5925b2A4Bf75d73ff6711cD0b29De85` may end higher than it started, at any amount, unlimited included, as the registry entry declares a standing allowance: written by the AI in the template: The router pulls tokens through Permit2 only from the address that called execute, its locker (msgSender() in Dispatcher.sol, set by Lock.sol): Permit2Payments.permit2TransferFrom takes msgSender() as the owner for V2, V3 and V4 swaps with payerIsUser and for PERMIT2\_TRANSFER\_FROM, and PERMIT2\_TRANSFER\_FROM\_BATCH reverts when a transfer's from is not the locker. It has no owner and no proxy. So a Permit2 allowance to it can be spent only by a later execute the Safe itself makes.; every other allowance may not rise.

## Code pins

Every span of each entry's registry code pin, oldest first: a span holds from its block to the block before the next span's. ## Protocol facts

What DefiLlama and the chain say about the protocols this template's calls go to, other than a token's issuer, and the size of what each card field can name. They decide nothing, and `verify` never reads them. TVL is DefiLlama's estimate. DefiLlama's hacks list holds only what someone reported, and a hack counts here only when DefiLlama files it under the protocol's DefiLlama id or its parent's. ## ERC-7730

`pnpm erc7730 usdc usdt morpho cbbtc safe-1.3.0 safe-1.4.1 permit2 universal-router-2.1.2 usp weeth`: each entry's calldata and EIP-712 descriptors in the pinned ERC-7730 registry, and each ERC-8176 attestation checked, for the entries the operation touches and every registry singleton, whose EIP-712 descriptor a wallet applies to the Safe transaction itself. A second opinion on field meanings, never a rule.
